edits.current: THE PER-EMPLOYEE, PER-MONTH SIDE of the ET art. 114-1 exoneration (introduced by Ley 1607 de 2012 and confirmed by Ley 1819 de 2016 art. 65). Values are S and N, not X. The employer-level flag in A1-033 declares eligibility; THIS field applies it to a specific employee in a specific month. TWO RULES APPLY TOGETHER. (1) The exoneration test is on the TOTAL EARNINGS of the month (total devengado): the employee is exonerated where the total devengado of the month is below 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026) - Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7. It is an earnings test, NOT a test on the health IBC. (2) In addition, AT2 v30 campo 76 requires N whenever the health contribution base in campo 43 (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV. The field is therefore S only where BOTH the total devengado and the health IBC are below 10 SMMLV. The test is monthly, so an employee who crosses 10 SMMLV because of a bonus loses the exoneration for that month alone - the engine must evaluate it every period, never once a year. Where marked S, the employer's health 8.5%, SENA 2% and ICBF 3% fall away and the health rate in T2R2-054 becomes the EMPLOYEE rate alone (4%); pension, occupational risk and the CCF 4% remain payable in full. The total devengado is the sum of the period's earnings; whether a wage type counts as an earning in this total comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) attribute of each wage type.
edits.proposed: THE PER-EMPLOYEE, PER-MONTH SIDE of the ET art. 114-1 exoneration (introduced by Ley 1607 de 2012 and confirmed by Ley 1819 de 2016 art. 65). Values are S and N, not X. The employer-level flag in A1-033 declares eligibility; THIS field applies it to a specific employee in a specific month. TWO RULES APPLY TOGETHER. (1) The exoneration test is on the TOTAL EARNINGS of the month (total devengado): the employee is exonerated where the total devengado of the month is below 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026) - Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7. It is an earnings test, NOT a test on the health IBC. (2) In addition, AT2 v30 campo 76 requires N whenever the health contribution base in campo 43 (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV. The field is therefore S only where BOTH the total devengado and the health IBC are below 10 SMMLV. The test is monthly, so an employee who crosses 10 SMMLV because of a bonus loses the exoneration for that month alone - the engine must evaluate it every period, never once a year. Where marked S, the employer's health 8.5%, SENA 2% and ICBF 3% fall away and the health rate in T2R2-054 becomes the EMPLOYEE rate alone (4%); pension, occupational risk and the CCF 4% remain payable in full. The total devengado is the totality of what the worker receives in the month - every payment of the period, salary and non-salary alike, whatever its character (Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7); the engine sums all earnings paid in the month without excluding any of them.

edits.current: A1-033 is an EMPLOYER-LEVEL, standing declaration that the employer qualifies under ET art. 114-1. T2R2-076 is a PER-EMPLOYEE, PER-MONTH application of it, and may be S only where A1-033 is S. The employee test has two parts: (a) the TOTAL EARNINGS of the month (total devengado) must be BELOW 10 SMMLV = COP 17,509,050 in 2026 (ET art. 114-1; Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7) - an earnings test, not an IBC test; and (b) in addition, where the health base (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV the field MUST be N (AT2 v30 campo 76). Where a NATURAL-person employer employs two or more workers and the base reaches 10 SMMLV it must also be N. Where T2R2-076 is S, set T2R2-054 to the EMPLOYEE rate alone (4.0000%), and set the SENA and ICBF rates and values (T2R2-066 to T2R2-069) to zero.

The employee test has two parts: (a) the TOTAL EARNINGS of the month (total devengado) - the totality of what the worker receives in the month, every payment of the period whatever its salary character (Decreto 1828 de 2013 art. 7) - must be BELOW 10 SMMLV = COP 17,509,050 in 2026 (ET art. 114-1) - an earnings test, not an IBC test; and (b) in addition, where the health base (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV the field MUST be N (AT2 v30 campo 76). Where a NATURAL-person employer employs two or more workers and the base reaches 10 SMMLV it must also be N. edits.current: Contribution base for the family compensation fund: the monthly salary payroll of the employee (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17). Same floor (1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905 in 2026) as the other three bases, but NO 25-SMMLV ceiling - the ceiling applies to the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC only. Bidirectional pair with 'All-inclusive salary flag' (T2R2-041), which where marked sets this base to 70% of the all-inclusive salary (Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49). Source: WT 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual' (uncapped), the base on which the CCF 4% (WT 25110 Family Compensation Fund) is computed.
edits.proposed: Contribution base for the family compensation fund: the monthly salary payroll of the employee (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17). Same floor (1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905 in 2026) as the other three bases, but NO 25-SMMLV ceiling - the ceiling applies to the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC only. Bidirectional pair with 'All-inclusive salary flag' (T2R2-041), which where marked sets this base to 70% of the all-inclusive salary (Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49). Source: the CCF base computed by the payroll engine under this rule (wage type 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual', uncapped, is the base on which the CCF 4%, wage type 25110 Family Compensation Fund, is computed). Campo 45 (this field) and campo 95 (T2R2-095) are two separate bases and may legitimately differ: each is populated under its own AT2 v30 rule - campo 45 is the base for the CCF contribution, campo 95 the base for SENA, ICBF, ESAP and MEN, which under Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 includes paid rest days - and the engine stores and reports them independently, never deriving one from the other.

edits.current: THE FIFTH AND MOST-MISSED BASE: IBC otros parafiscales diferentes a CCF - the base for SENA, ICBF, ESAP and MEN. Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 defines it differently from the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC: it includes paid rest days and it is UNCAPPED - the 25-SMMLV ceiling does not apply. Header campo T2R1-020 is the sum of campo 45 (IBC CCF), NOT of this field. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 95. For an all-inclusive (integral) salary this base is 70% of the integral salary, like the IBC fields (CST art. 132; Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49). Source: WT 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual' (uncapped; includes paid vacation WT 79401), the base on which SENA 2% (WT 25112) and ICBF 3% (WT 25111) are computed.
edits.proposed: THE FIFTH AND MOST-MISSED BASE: IBC otros parafiscales diferentes a CCF - the base for SENA, ICBF, ESAP and MEN. Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 defines it differently from the pension, health and occupational-risk IBC: it includes paid rest days and it is UNCAPPED - the 25-SMMLV ceiling does not apply. Header campo T2R1-020 is the sum of campo 45 (IBC CCF), NOT of this field. Source: AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 95. For an all-inclusive (integral) salary this base is 70% of the integral salary, like the IBC fields (CST art. 132; Ley 789 de 2002 art. 49). Source: the parafiscal base computed by the payroll engine under this rule (wage type 64991 'Parafiscals Base actual', uncapped, including paid vacation wage type 79401, is the base on which SENA 2%, wage type 25112, and ICBF 3%, wage type 25111, are computed). Campo 95 and campo 45 (T2R2-045) are two separate bases populated under their own AT2 v30 rules and may legitimately differ; the engine stores and reports them independently, never deriving one from the other.
